name: Improved Unarmed Strike
description: You count as armed when unarmed, so you don't provoke attacks of opportunity, and you can deal lethal or nonlethal damage.

name: Deflect Arrows
description: With a free hand, once per round avoid the damage from one ranged attack you are aware of.

name: Snatch Arrows
description: When you deflect a ranged attack, you can catch the weapon instead. Thrown weapons can be thrown back.

name: Improved Grapple
description: No attack of opportunity when you grapple. +2 on grapple checks and +2 CMD against being grappled.

name: Greater Grapple
description: Another +2 on grapple checks. Maintaining a grapple is a move action.

name: Scorpion Style
description: An unarmed strike that reduces the target's speed to 5 feet unless it makes a Fortitude save.

name: Gorgon's Fist
description: An unarmed strike against a foe whose speed is reduced staggers it unless it makes a Fortitude save.

name: Medusa's Wrath
description: On a full attack including an unarmed strike, make two extra unarmed strikes against a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe.

name: Stunning Fist
description: Declare before an unarmed attack. A foe you damage must make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round. Usable a limited number of times per day.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: Reduce the penalties for fighting with two weapons (primary hand by 2, off hand by 6).

name: Double Slice
description: Add your full Strength bonus to damage with your off-hand weapon.

name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
description: A second off-hand attack, at a -5 penalty.

name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
description: A third off-hand attack, at a -10 penalty.

name: Two-Weapon Rend
description: If you hit a foe with both weapons, deal an extra 1d10 plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier, once per round.

name: Two-Weapon Defense
description: +1 shield bonus to AC while wielding two weapons (+2 when fighting defensively or using total defense).

name: Shield Proficiency
description: A shield's armor check penalty applies only to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills. Most martial classes have this already.

name: Improved Shield Bash
description: Keep your shield's AC bonus when you shield bash.

name: Shield Slam
description: Foes hit by your shield bash are also hit with a free bull rush.

name: Shield Master
description: No two-weapon penalties when attacking with a shield, and its enhancement bonus applies to attack and damage.

name: Shield Focus
description: Increase the AC bonus from any shield you use by 1.

name: Greater Shield Focus
description: Another +1 to the AC bonus from any shield you use.

name: Tower Shield Proficiency
description: A tower shield's armor check penalty applies only to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills.

name: Armor Proficiency, Light
description: No attack penalty in light armor, and its armor check penalty applies only to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills. Everyone but monks, sorcerers, and wizards has this already.

name: Armor Proficiency, Medium
description: The same benefit as Light, for medium armor.

name: Armor Proficiency, Heavy
description: The same benefit as Light, for heavy armor.

name: Arcane Armor Training
description: As a swift action, reduce your arcane spell failure chance from armor by 10% for spells cast this round.

name: Arcane Armor Mastery
description: As a swift action, reduce your arcane spell failure chance from armor by 20% for spells cast this round. Replaces, and does not stack with, Arcane Armor Training.

name: Vital Strike
description: With the attack action, make one attack at your highest bonus that rolls the weapon's damage dice twice.

name: Improved Vital Strike
description: As Vital Strike, but the weapon's damage dice are rolled three times.

name: Greater Vital Strike
description: As Vital Strike, but the weapon's damage dice are rolled four times.

name: Lunge
description: Increase your melee reach by 5 feet until the end of your turn, at a -2 penalty to AC until your next turn.

name: Step Up
description: When an adjacent foe takes a 5-foot step away, take a 5-foot step as an immediate action to stay adjacent.

name: Strike Back
description: Ready an action to make a melee attack against a foe that attacks you from outside your reach.

name: Blind-Fight
description: Reroll melee miss chances from concealment once, and invisible attackers get no special advantage against you in melee.

name: Catch Off-Guard
description: No penalty for improvised melee weapons, and unarmed opponents are flat-footed against them.

name: Throw Anything
description: No penalty for improvised ranged weapons, and a +1 circumstance bonus on attacks with thrown splash weapons.

name: Improvised Weapon Mastery
description: No penalties with improvised weapons, damage one step higher, and a 19-20/x2 critical range.

name: Intimidating Prowess
description: Add your Strength modifier to Intimidate checks, in addition to Charisma.
